summary: Competitor/market-actor records exist in the schema but cannot be created, listed or displayed, so competition research has nowhere typed to land
expected: A way to register market actors (name, website, description) and link them to an idea revision with relation competitor/alternative/partner/benchmark, primary flag, note (what it does / the gap), check date and source refs; idea page shows a competition table.
actual: `foundry market-actor ...` is not a CLI resource; `MarketActor`/`IdeaMarketActor` in domain.py have no service, CLI, HTTP route or template usage. The only option is unstructured evidence text via `change record`.
reproduction: `python3 tools/foundry_agent.py cli market-actor list` → 'invalid choice: market-actor'. `grep -rn MarketActor src/startup_foundry/*.py | grep -v domain.py` returns nothing.
impact: Five competition research passes (orchestration, routing, specialist factories, AI OS platforms, research systems) for AS01–AS09 cannot be recorded as reusable actor records; the 'competition' scoring penalty cannot cite typed competitor links; comparisons across ideas lose reuse.
suggestion: Add `market-actor register/list/show` and `idea link-actor --input` writing IdeaMarketActor on the current revision (with checked_on and source refs), expose `competition` in `idea show` and an idea-page table. Being implemented in package F02.
